title: Zesty Kenyan Chicken Stew
description: A floral and bouncy Kenyan dish perfect for a sick day, featuring a miso marinate and diabetic-friendly ingredients, made with boiling water.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, lemon juice, and olive oil to make the marinade.
Add the chicken to the marinade and mix well to coat, then cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
In a large pot, saute the onion, garlic, and ginger in a little bit of olive oil over medium heat until the onion is translucent.
Add the marinated chicken to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and add the thyme, salt, and pepper, then simmer for 20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Let the stew cool completely before refrigerating or freezing for later use.
Reheat the stew gently over low heat, adding a little bit of water if it has thickened too much.
